capabilities.text: Automatically trigger spreadsheet step when nurse saves ward note
capabilities.quote: The spreadsheet step is automatically triggered when the nurse saves the ward note in the system — no extra action needed.

capabilities.text: Send email alert to ward manager daily at 7:30 a.m. with patient list and note link
capabilities.quote: The ward manager gets an email alert every morning at 7:30 a.m. with a list of patients who have new notes since the previous day, including a link to view the note and download the updated spreadsheet.

capabilities.text: Send reminder to nurse and team leader at 10 a.m. the next day if a note is forgotten
capabilities.quote: If a nurse forgets to enter a note, the system sends a reminder to them and their team leader at 10 a.m. the next day.

capabilities.text: Connect to existing patient management system (InHealth)
capabilities.quote: It needs to connect to the existing patient management system — which we call InHealth

capabilities.text: Connect to central reporting spreadsheet system (ShareSheet)
capabilities.quote: and the central reporting spreadsheet system, which is called ShareSheet.

capabilities.text: Update ShareSheet with nurse's note by 8 a.m. the next day
capabilities.quote: and the same note must appear in ShareSheet by 8 a.m. the next day.

capabilities.text: Flag connection failures to IT team via email
capabilities.quote: If one connection fails, the system should flag it to the IT team via email

capabilities.text: Allow nurse to enter note even if connection fails
capabilities.quote: but the nurse can still enter the note — we’d rather have the note than lose it because of a connection issue.

capabilities.text: Care coordinator uses ShareSheet daily to plan tasks
capabilities.quote: The care coordinator opens ShareSheet every morning to plan the day’s tasks, like who needs medication changes or physiotherapy.

capabilities.text: Quality team downloads ShareSheet weekly to check note entry deadlines
capabilities.quote: The regional quality team downloads it weekly to check if all notes are being entered within 24 hours

capabilities.text: Finance supervisor uses ShareSheet monthly to match nurse hours with patient interactions
capabilities.quote: The finance supervisor also uses it once a month to match nurse hours with documented patient interactions.

capabilities.text: Log missed notes as delays in quality team's weekly report after second offense in a week
capabilities.quote: If the note still isn’t entered by 11 a.m., the system logs it as a delay in the quality team’s weekly report — but only if it's the second time in a week for that nurse.

capabilities.text: Team leader gets alert at 10:15 a.m. for pending notes, including nurse and patient name
capabilities.quote: the team leader gets an alert at 10:15 a.m. with the nurse’s name and patient full name.

capabilities.text: Alert includes direct link to the note entry page
capabilities.quote: The alert includes a direct link to the note entry page.

capabilities.text: Use JavaScript and .NET for development
capabilities.quote: I’ll make sure the build team uses JavaScript and .NET

capabilities.text: Use secure internal APIs for system connections
capabilities.quote: and the secure internal APIs they already know.

capabilities.text: Use the same login system as InHealth
capabilities.quote: I’d also want them to use the same login system as InHealth — no extra passwords for nurses.

capabilities.text: Log sync delays with timestamp and alert IT within 5 minutes
capabilities.quote: If there’s any delay in syncing the note to ShareSheet, the system should log it with a timestamp and alert the IT team within 5 minutes

capabilities.text: Version one ready by start of next quarterly review cycle (six weeks)
capabilities.quote: I’d say version one needs to be ready by the start of the next quarterly review cycle — that’s in six weeks.

capabilities.text: Core functionality (note entry, sync by 8 a.m., 10:15 a.m. alert) ready by week five
capabilities.quote: That means the build team has to finish the core functionality — note entry, sync to ShareSheet by 8 a.m., and the 10:15 a.m. alert — by week five.

capabilities.text: Note must appear in ShareSheet by 8 a.m. reliably
capabilities.quote: The most important thing is that the note they type once in InHealth must appear in ShareSheet by 8 a.m. the next day — no exceptions, no delays.

capabilities.text: Display clear error message on silent failure
capabilities.quote: I’d rather the system show a clear error message than silently fail.

capabilities.text: Provide clear instructions on how to handle failures
capabilities.quote: And if it does fail, the nurse must know exactly what to do — like retry or contact IT — not just wonder if it worked.

capabilities.text: Handle approximately 400 to 640 note entries daily without slowing down
capabilities.quote: so we’re looking at roughly 400 to 640 note entries daily. The system must handle that load without slowing down
